import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import json
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.8,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.8,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.5,
    'lines.markersize': 5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.02,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'cm',
})

CB_BLUE = '#0173B2'
CB_ORANGE = '#DE8F05'
CB_GREEN = '#029E73'
CB_RED = '#D55E00'
CB_PURPLE = '#CC78BC'
CB_GREY = '#949494'

OUT = '/root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress/artifacts/figures'

# ── Fig 1: G3 vs k_ratio ──
with open('eval_results/pruning_sweep_v2.json') as f:
    d1 = json.load(f)

k = np.array(d1['k_ratios'])
g3 = np.array(d1['g3_values'])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.5))
ax.plot(k, g3, 'o-', color=CB_BLUE, zorder=3)
ax.axhline(y=1.0, color=CB_GREY, ls='--', lw=0.8, label='$G_3=1.0$ (baseline)')
ax.axhline(y=1.1, color=CB_RED, ls=':', lw=0.8, label='$G_3=1.1$ (pass threshold)')

# sweet spot shading
ax.axvspan(0.5, 0.6, alpha=0.12, color=CB_GREEN, zorder=0)
best_idx = np.argmin(g3)
ax.annotate(f'$G_3^*={g3[best_idx]:.3f}$\n$k={k[best_idx]}$',
            xy=(k[best_idx], g3[best_idx]),
            xytext=(k[best_idx]+0.12, g3[best_idx]+0.15),
            fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=0.8),
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec=CB_GREY, lw=0.5))

ax.set_xlabel('Retention ratio $k$')
ax.set_ylabel('$G_3$ (action loss ratio)')
ax.set_xlim(0.25, 0.95)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.15)
ax.set_xticks(k)
ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig_g3_vs_kratio.pdf')
plt.close(fig)
print('Fig 1 done')

# ── Fig 2: Theoretical vs Empirical Bound ──
with open('results/formal_bound_plan005.json') as f:
    d2 = json.load(f)

eps = np.array(d2['epsilon_values'])
emp = np.array(d2['empirical_stability'])
th_emp = np.array(d2['theoretical_bound_empirical_L'])
th_spec = np.array(d2['theoretical_bound_spectral_L'])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.5))
ax.plot(eps, emp, 's-', color=CB_BLUE, label='Empirical stability', zorder=3)
ax.plot(eps, th_emp, '^--', color=CB_ORANGE, label=f'Bound ($L_{{emp}}={d2["lipschitz_L_empirical"]:.3f}$)', zorder=2)
ax.plot(eps, th_spec, 'v:', color=CB_RED, label=f'Bound ($L_{{spec}}={d2["lipschitz_L_spectral"]:.3f}$)', zorder=2)

# shading between empirical and spectral bound
ax.fill_between(eps, th_spec, emp, alpha=0.08, color=CB_ORANGE, zorder=0)

# tightness annotation
tight_vals = emp / th_emp
mean_tight = np.mean(tight_vals)
ax.annotate(f'Tightness ratio: {mean_tight:.3f}',
            xy=(0.05, 0.5*(emp[3]+th_emp[3])),
            xytext=(0.015, 0.955),
            fontsize=7.5,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=0.8),
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec=CB_GREY, lw=0.5))

ax.set_xscale('log')
ax.set_xlabel('Perturbation $\\varepsilon$')
ax.set_ylabel('Top-$k$ preservation rate')
ax.set_ylim(0.84, 1.005)
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(ticker.NullFormatter())
ax.set_xticks(eps)
ax.set_xticklabels([f'{e}' for e in eps])
ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='lower left', framealpha=0.9)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig_theoretical_vs_empirical_bound.pdf')
plt.close(fig)
print('Fig 2 done')

# ── Fig 3: Token Importance–Gradient Correlation ──
with open('results/token_importance_analysis/gradient_correlation.json') as f:
    d3 = json.load(f)

rho_samples = np.array(d3['spearman_correlation']['per_sample'])
rho_mean = d3['spearman_correlation']['mean']
rho_std = d3['spearman_correlation']['std']
grad_ret = d3['gradient_stats']['retained_mean']
grad_pru = d3['gradient_stats']['pruned_mean']
grad_ratio = d3['gradient_stats']['ratio']

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(3.5, 2.2), gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.6, 1]})

# Left: histogram of per-sample Spearman rho
ax1.hist(rho_samples, bins=20, color=CB_BLUE, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='white', lw=0.5)
ax1.axvline(rho_mean, color=CB_RED, ls='--', lw=1.2)
ax1.text(rho_mean + 0.02, ax1.get_ylim()[1]*0.01, f'$\\bar{{\\rho}}={rho_mean:.3f}$',
         fontsize=8, color=CB_RED, va='bottom')
ax1.set_xlabel('Spearman $\\rho$')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.set_xlim(0, 0.7)

# Right: bar chart retained vs pruned gradient
bars = ax2.bar(['Retained', 'Pruned'],
               [grad_ret * 1e4, grad_pru * 1e4],
               color=[CB_GREEN, CB_ORANGE], width=0.55, edgecolor='white', lw=0.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('Grad. magnitude ($\\times 10^{-4}$)')
ax2.annotate(f'{grad_ratio:.2f}$\\times$', xy=(0.5, max(grad_ret, grad_pru)*1e4*0.92),
             fontsize=9, ha='center', fontweight='bold', color=CB_RED)

# bracket
ymax = grad_ret * 1e4
ax2.annotate('', xy=(0, ymax*1.05), xytext=(1, ymax*1.05),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color=CB_RED, lw=1.0))

ax2.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8)
fig.tight_layout(w_pad=1.8)
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig_token_importance_correlation.pdf')
plt.close(fig)
print('Fig 3 done')
print('All figures saved to', OUT)
